title: Greece-Turkey population exchange
summary: A convention signed on 30 January 1923 made a compulsory exchange by religion: about 1.2 million Greek Orthodox Christians, many of whom had already fled, and 355,000-400,000 Muslims from Greece were displaced.
why: A treaty-ordered mutual expulsion of over 1.5 million people, decided by religion.

notes.problem: 'Swapped' and 'left' soften a compulsory expulsion (source: 'compulsory population exchange, or agreed mutual expulsion'); most Greeks had already fled before the formal exchange.
